label: Type 2 diabetes
red_flag_symptoms: shakiness, sweating or confusion that could be low blood sugar
a foot wound or blister that is getting worse
sources: ADA Standards of Care: Physical Activity and Exercise
WHO 2020 Guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour
guidance: Short blocks after meals help glucose uptake more than a single long session.
Prefer low-impact movement, and check feet afterwards.
If you take insulin or a sulfonylurea, keep a fast-acting carbohydrate nearby.
